BETA Close X Associated British Foods PLC has announced the repurchase of 25,434 of its ordinary shares on 27 July 2026, as part of its ongoing share repurchase program. The average price paid per share was GBp 2001.7777, with the highest price at GBp 2009.0000 and the lowest at GBp 1993.0000. These shares were purchased from Barclays Capital Securities Limited and will be cancelled. The total value of this transaction amounts to approximately £509,000.
